title: CrackedObsidian
description: Obsidian is the and all Be all for a raidproof base, but it being completely invulnerable is boring! Now Obsidian takes damage and can be overcome with enough explosives but still takes way more punishment than the other blocks!
body:
Obsidian is the and all Be all for a raidproof base, but it being completely invulnerable is boring!
Now Obsidian takes damage and can be overcome with enough explosives but still takes way more punishment than the other blocks!

You can also instantly repair the half broken Obsidian blocks with the new Obsidian Glue item so you don't have to replace your damaged wall 1 block at a time!

Configurable:
- Damage Stages, This is the total number of Explosions Obsidian can withstand before breaking
- Explosionresistance, of Obsidian and the new Damaged Obsidian blocks. This changes the radius at wich explosions apply damage to Obsidian, it also defines an explosion strength treshold that can begin to apply damage to Obsidian.
